items.title: Jensen Huang, a Leader of the Global AI Boom, Is Out as Nvidia CEO
items.take: Yesterday's episode is the story of the week: Huang resigned Thursday morning after reports of multiple affairs, ending a three-decade run as the face of the AI boom. Friday's episode is up too, leading with Schumer Has Competition for Senate minority leader.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq slip as Nvidia stock falls on CEO exit, bond yields rise
items.take: Indexes fell Thursday as investors weighed rising bond yields and fresh uncertainty around the AI trade after Huang's exit, with Nvidia down more than 4%. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed above 5%, and one Wall Street veteran summed up the mood: sad about Jensen, Shakespearean.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500 futures rise, Nvidia CEO exit remains in focus
items.take: Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones board chair while launching a permanent successor search, and the paper reports Trump had urged Huang to fight for his job on a Tuesday call, two days before the resignation. Markets price a 100% likelihood of a December hike, with the 10-year at 5.12%.

items.title: Stock market today: live updates
items.take: Stocks pointed up early Friday as a cooler-than-expected wholesale inflation reading landed and Nvidia rebounded about 2% in premarket trading. Chicago Fed president Goolsbee said the central bank has more work to do to restore its credibility on inflation.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Nasdaq Up 3.2% for the Week as Kress Steps In at Nvidia
items.take: For all the drama, the week still finished strong on the tech side: the Nasdaq gained 3.2% over the five sessions. Watch for Cisco and Applied Materials earnings after the close tonight.
